entries.title: Order and shopping list fix
changes: Crafting: the Order & shopping list no longer cuts off or hides rows when you order several pieces, and it now fits on a phone screen.

entries.title: Suggested market prices
changes: Crafting and Loadouts now fill in suggested material prices from the KCDRoleplay auction houses (7-day average sale price, snapshot dated on the page), so costs work straight away.
Anything you type still wins over a suggestion, and a new Use suggested market prices tick box turns them off.

entries.title: What's new button, tour and faster loading
changes: Pages now show a loading message while they build (with a hint if your connection is slow), and a thin bar when you move to another page.
New What's new button in the top bar (this list).
A guided tour of every page, offered on your first visit and available any time from the Tour button.
Pages open faster on repeat visits and now work offline after your first visit.
Crafting: filter by type within each craft (Swords, Helmets, Furniture and more).
Crafting: before you enter prices, Sell at and Profit show a dash so they do not look like real results. There is also a filter box for materials.
Phones: the top bar fits on one row.
Recipes are now checked against the wiki every day.

entries.title: Recipe updates
changes: Tailoring recipes brought in line with the wiki.
New Smithing recipes: Adorned axe (from the relic) and Henry's sword reforged. Broken axe and Henry's longsword can now be priced as materials.
Safer handling of saved loadouts and restored backups.
